product_constraint: MTP 1.5x–3x committed Decode on same real API workloads, drafts 2/3, exact target state/logits/output; paired Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total.

downward_budget.limitation: Graph span includes projections and inner gaps, not recurrence-only latency. No per-kernel speed forecast or hardware bound.

lineage.original_scalar: gated_delta_net_update_kernel already assigns one value row per thread but reads strided scalar global state twice and performs unfused final normalization. That ownership alone is not new.
lineage.retained_eight_row: Eight active dot lanes per warp; all lanes cooperatively load/update 8x128 state in shared scratch. Two batches cover the head.
lineage.old_m16_and_v81: Packed state partitions held by key-owning lanes across tokens; still uses shared state scratch and partial dot-lane activity. Neither holds a complete state row in each thread.
lineage.difference: Fixed 128-thread CTA per value head. Each thread vector-loads its full BF16 state row into 64 packed registers once, computes original prediction/update/output serial FMA chains locally, then vector-stores its complete rounded state. No row-batch scan or cross-token state reuse.

ledger: Same 128-lane Q/K tree and scalar alpha/beta. Original BF16 state remains stored in canonical row-major format.

Packed register words preserve all bits. Recompute alpha*S for the update pass exactly as the original scalar reference; explicit FP32 multiplication precedes each FMA. No algebraic prediction/output simplification.
Each prediction and output uses ascending 128-key FP32 FMA chain, starting +0. Updated state is rounded BF16; current output uses the unrounded FP32 update.

Keep BF16 raw output encode/decode, the 256-lane normalization tree including its first addition of zero, and original norm/SiLU/gate order. Intermediate raw output need not reach global memory because it has no external observer inside the fused kernel.
Per-token recurrence, Conv producer/copy, immutable prefix slots, canonical full commit, graphs, draft and numerical baseline remain unchanged. No new allocation or production dispatch.

Trade less-coalesced row vector accesses and repeated alpha multiplies against eliminating shared state scratch, warp transfers and inactive dot lanes. Real API selects, not theoretical lane utilization.
validation: Compile/resource gate, complete M2/3/4 output/state/guards/Graph comparison, bounded root race/sync, complete P65 numerical and transactions, then immediate d2 short/8K/40K API. Short >3% regression or nonpositive8K stops; useful direction unlocks d3; neutral removes. No further launch/register/packing variants.
retention_expiry: One API return selects removal or bounded prerequisite through next full verifier architecture return/archival.

compile_contract_repair.initial: 255 registers,72-byte stack,68-byte spill stores/loads; no GPU process started. Compiler CSE defeats intended packed-state lifetime.
compile_contract_repair.repair: One bounded implementation correction: volatile exact PTX BF16-bit decode/mul and shared consumption prevent carrying decoded state and normalized keys between passes. Same layout, geometry, arithmetic and unchanged resource gate. No register-cap or performance scan.
compile_contract_repair.stop: If this correction still fails declared resources, close before GPU. No further implementation/resource variant.
